definitions.explanation: A situation where traffic or other movement is slowed or stopped due to high volume.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ}が{渋滞|じゅうたい}している。
{渋滞|じゅうたい}で{会議|かいぎ}に{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: I was late to the meeting because of traffic.

examples.japanese: {連休|れんきゅう}は{渋滞|じゅうたい}がひどい。
examples.english: Traffic is terrible during consecutive holidays.

notes:
{渋滞|じゅうたい}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to be congested."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渋滞|じゅうたい}する (to be congested)
- {渋滞|じゅうたい}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる (to get caught in traffic)
- {交通|こうつう}{渋滞|じゅうたい} (traffic congestion)
- {渋滞|じゅうたい}{情報|じょうほう} (traffic information)
- {渋滞|じゅうたい}を{避|さ}ける (to avoid traffic)
- 10キロの{渋滞|じゅうたい} (10 km traffic backup)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traffic jams ({渋滞|じゅうたい}) are notorious during お{盆|ぼん} (mid-August) and {年末|ねんまつ}{年始|ねんし} (New Year period) in Japan.
